independence_constraint: Compare exported outputs and metadata without sharing implementation code.

hypotheses.statement: CLAHE may improve detector recall in dark or low-contrast scenes, but gains may be offset by texture artifacts.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Keep CLAHE only if validation recall and failure-case review improve or remain stable within the runtime budget.

hypotheses.statement: Photometric enhancement may help visibility while reducing class-cue fidelity in color-cast or turbid scenes.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Reject a visually brighter condition if class discrimination or localization worsens.

hypotheses.statement: Rare classes and small objects will show larger enhancement variance than common, large objects.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Report gains and losses by class; do not select a method from aggregate mAP alone.

hypotheses.statement: Adjacent frames can make random image-level splits appear stronger than sequence-held-out evaluation.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Use the group-safe split for all claims; random splitting is diagnostic only and never the reported protocol.

hypotheses.statement: Peer agreement will be lower for ambiguous class boundaries and partial occlusions than for clear objects.
hypotheses.decision_rule: Escalate disagreements that change class identity, object presence, or split assignment.
